macros.name: affiliation
macros.doc: Author names are specified with the \author macro while affiliations (or addresses) are specified with the \affiliation macro.

macros.name: collaboration
macros.doc: Specify the collaboration (given after a group of authors).

macros.name: date
macros.doc: Use the \date command to specify the document date, the \received command to specify the date received, \revised for date revised, \accepted for date accepted, and \published for date published.

macros.name: email
macros.doc: Just tacks the email address on to the current author or affiliation.

macros.name: keywords
macros.doc: A \keywords macro may also be used to indicate keywords for the article.

macros.name: noaffiliation
macros.doc: If an author doesn’t have an affiliation, the \noaffiliation macro may be used in the place of an \affiliation macro.

macros.name: preprint
macros.doc: Institutional report numbers can be specified using the \preprint macro.

macros.name: title
macros.doc: The title of the manuscript is simply specified by using the \title{⟨title⟩} macro.
